title: MARK-I: Mission Pilot
description:
• THE YEAR IS 21XX 

• CORPORATIONS GAINED POWER WITH THEIR TECHNOLOGIES AND TOOK CONTROL OVER THE WORLD 

• GOVERNMENTS FORCED TO SURVIVE AGAINST MILITIRIZED CORPORATIONS BY ACCUMULATING ARMORED FORCES AND RESEARCHES 

• WITH MARK-I – NEW PROTOTYPE OF INTELLIGENT COMBAT UNIT...

 

ARCADE SHOOTERCasual top-down shoot 'em up inspired by classic titles of 80s-90s. Repeat short but high-paced Mission Pilot for unlockable difficulties to harden your skills and became true experienced Pilot. 

 

COOP FOR 2 PLAYERSComplete the mission with your partner in optional synchronous single-screen cooperative. Combine different play-styles to create powerful binding. 

 

MINIMALISTIC DESIGNUnique stylized graphics with a lot of dynamic and destructible environment objects. Levels crafted with love and attention to details and quality. 

 

EXPLOSIVE ACTION!Use upgrades to create your custom MARK-I configuration to unleash full potential in combats. Master battle situations and be ready for surpising game sequences. 

 

The game contains one ~20 minutes short mission with ability to replay it on different difficulties – solo or with a friend on same screen. I appreciate any kind of support.
description_short: Arcade top-down shooter with coop for 2 players. Play as Pilot of 「MARK-I」 – new prototype of intelligent combat unit. Complete short intense action mission by shooting enemies, avoiding threats and upgrading shell with different battle configurations.
